openFindings.title: Goal D5 bump gate fails: 9 of 14 touched skills carry no bump or changelog entry
Templates asset lists version as a Required Field for the Skill README and Feature Catalog child templates
Post-edit quality README still documents the pre-change frontmatter-versions dispatch scope
Dead child-doc derivation branch and unreachable git-walk machinery remain in the engine
Versioning standard example cites a superseded system-spec-kit version that the same change set bumped
Completion ledger is still the template scaffold: 0 of 17 rows, no Tests table
Router catalog/playbook scope mapper and table have no production caller after the SKILL.md-only narrowing
SKILL.md predicate spelled five ways in the engine, vestigial skillsRoot parameters, unread openIdx field
Strip executed a narrower scope than the standard MUST-NOT statement: 47 child docs still carry frontmatter version lines
